page.overview:
Who is Tomatito?

Tomatito is a musician who lives in Dressrosa.

Tomatito is a lanky man with a square jaw and long black hair tied in a ponytail. He wears a light yellow shirt under a black vest and sports round sunglasses. He tends to carry a spanish guitar around.

Tomatito appears to be a friendly individual who is not intimidated by pirates.

Tomatito apparently became well-acquainted with Lola after she came to Dressrosa, enough to mistake her twin sister Chiffon for her.
